feature: HM-516 — Profile Page authored posts and uploaded media

scenarios.title: Default Posts tab selected and posts displayed in reverse chronological order
scenarios.preconditions: User is authenticated and has at least 5 public posts
scenarios.steps:
Given the user navigates to their Profile Page
When the screen loads
Then the "Posts" tab must be selected by default
And the system queries the Post API and returns posts sorted newest to oldest
And the first 10 posts are rendered in the list
scenarios.expected_result: The Posts tab is active and the list shows the 10 most recent posts with correct order

scenarios.title: Infinite scroll loads next set of posts when scrolled to bottom
scenarios.preconditions: User has 25 posts
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page with the Posts tab active
When the user scrolls to the bottom of the post list
Then the system requests the next 10 posts via the Post API
And the new posts are appended to the list
scenarios.expected_result: 15 posts are visible after first scroll, 25 after second scroll

scenarios.title: Post text truncated at 200 characters with "Read more" link
scenarios.preconditions: User has a post with 250 characters of text
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the post list is rendered
Then the post card displays only the first 200 characters followed by "Read more"
And clicking "Read more" expands to full text
scenarios.expected_result: 200-char preview shown; full text revealed on click

scenarios.title: Post card displays media preview correctly for image posts
scenarios.preconditions: User has a post with an image URL
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the post list is rendered
Then the media preview area shows the image thumbnail
And clicking the thumbnail opens the image in a lightbox
scenarios.expected_result: Thumbnail visible and lightbox opens with full image

scenarios.title: Post card shows visibility icon for followers-only posts
scenarios.preconditions: User has a followers-only post
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the post list is rendered
Then the visibility icon indicates "followers-only"
And the post is not visible to non-followers in API response

scenarios.title: Empty profile shows no posts and displays placeholder message
scenarios.preconditions: User has zero posts
scenarios.steps:
Given the user navigates to their Profile Page
When the screen loads
Then the system queries the Post API and receives an empty list
And the UI displays "You have no posts yet" message
scenarios.expected_result: No post cards rendered; placeholder visible
edge_cases: API returns null instead of empty array

scenarios.title: API returns error 500 during post fetch shows error banner
scenarios.preconditions: Post API is mocked to return 500
scenarios.steps:
Given the user navigates to their Profile Page
When the system requests posts
Then the API returns 500
And the UI displays an error banner with retry option
scenarios.expected_result: Error banner visible; retry button functional

scenarios.title: User with 11 posts sees pagination load 10 then 1
scenarios.preconditions: User has 11 posts
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the user scrolls to bottom once
Then the system fetches the next 10 posts
And only 1 additional post is displayed

scenarios.title: Rapid scrolling triggers multiple API calls but no duplicate posts
scenarios.preconditions: User has 30 posts
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the user scrolls rapidly to bottom multiple times
Then the system queues API requests but ensures each post appears only once

scenarios.title: Session expires during infinite scroll and user is redirected to login
scenarios.preconditions: User session expires after 5 minutes
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page and has scrolled halfway
When the session token expires
Then subsequent API calls return 401
And the UI redirects to the login page
scenarios.expected_result: Login page displayed; no stale data shown

scenarios.title: Post with zero-width space in text renders correctly and truncates
scenarios.preconditions: Post text contains zero-width spaces
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the post list is rendered
Then the text is displayed without visible gaps
And truncation occurs at 200 visible characters
scenarios.expected_result: Text appears continuous; truncation logic works

scenarios.title: RTL language post displays correctly and truncates at 200 chars
scenarios.preconditions: User has a post in Arabic with 250 chars
scenarios.steps:
Given the user switches locale to Arabic
When the Profile Page loads
Then the post card displays RTL text
And truncation occurs after 200 chars

scenarios.title: Copy-paste HTML into post text field is sanitized and stored as plain text
scenarios.preconditions: User is creating a new post
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the New Post form
When the user pastes '<script>alert(1)</script>' into the text area
Then the system sanitizes input to plain text
And the stored post contains 'alert(1)' without script tags
scenarios.expected_result: No script execution; plain text stored

scenarios.title: Back button after viewing post detail returns to correct scroll position
scenarios.preconditions: User has scrolled 3 posts down and opens a post detail
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page and scrolled to post #3
When the user clicks on the post to view details
And then clicks the browser back button
Then the Profile Page reloads with scroll position at post #3
scenarios.expected_result: User returns to same spot without losing context
edge_cases: Back button pressed before detail loads

scenarios.title: Keyboard navigation can focus and activate "Read more" link
scenarios.preconditions: User has a post with truncated text
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the user tabs through post cards
And focuses on the "Read more" link
Then pressing Enter expands the post text

scenarios.title: Responsive layout shows single column on mobile and two columns on tablet
scenarios.preconditions: User accesses Profile Page on different viewports
scenarios.steps:
Given the user opens the Profile Page on a 375px width device
When the page renders
Then posts are displayed in a single column
And on a 768px width device
Then posts are displayed in two columns

scenarios.title: API injection attempt in post ID returns 400 and no data leak
scenarios.preconditions: User attempts to fetch post with ID '<script>'
scenarios.steps:
Given the user navigates to /profile/posts?postId=<script>
When the system queries the Post API
Then the API returns 400 Bad Request
And no post data is returned

scenarios.title: Post card shows engagement stats correctly even when zero likes/comments
scenarios.preconditions: User has a post with 0 likes and 0 comments
scenarios.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the post list is rendered
Then the engagement stats display '0 likes • 0 comments'

scenarios.title: Switching between Posts and Media tabs preserves scroll position per tab
scenarios.preconditions: User has scrolled in both tabs
scenarios.steps:
Given the user scrolls to post #5 in Posts tab
When the user switches to Media tab and scrolls to media #3
Then the user switches back to Posts tab
Then the scroll position is at post #5

coverage_summary: Covers happy path, boundaries, negative paths, combination edge cases, weird data, security, accessibility, UI responsiveness, and API contract checks for Profile Page authored posts and uploaded media. CSV export was excluded because the verified HM-516 story summary is Profile Page content history and digital footprint, not export.
assumptions: Jira HM-516 is not accessible from this environment, so local HM-516_full_20260512.json and existing HM-516 feature files were used as story context.
Posts tab page size is 10 and Media tab page size is 12 based on existing local HM-516 cases.
Uploaded media may include image, video, and document files.
Exact API paths may need alignment with implementation routes before automation.
